item.description:

item.title: [6.7] Deterministic Prompting for Speaker-Stable Low-Resource Greek TTS
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Modern TTS systems approach human quality for high-resource languages but degrade when clean speech data is scarce. Modern Greek exemplifies this, lacking the curated corpora behind state-of-the-art synthesis. We propose a data curation recipe that transforms audiobook recordings into TTS-ready data via WhisperX alignment and filtering.
